requirementsImplemented.note: AttemptEvidenceManifestV1 (frozen) with stable id, parent lineage, task class, book/chapter, input hashes (packet/projection/plan/brief), exec-profile hash via inputHashes, expected base + retention class; opened at mint.

linkExecutionContext binds the IMP-00 effective-context manifest path + route sidecar post-spawn (mint precedes the spawn that produces them); recordSpawnEvidence wires it in author/repair conductors.

Raw journal.jsonl mirrors every transition append-only (never replaced by a summary); final message + card stored content-addressed. Consuming the codex --json usage/event stream verbatim is IMP-11 telemetry (local text route exposes no token events).

Exact rendered writer cards stored content-addressed for recorded attempts; renderer/version hashes ride inputHashes for deterministic re-render proof. Reviewer phase-doc storage uses the same API; call-site wiring lands with IMP-08.

Candidate chapter bytes + commit manifest content-addressed and deduplicated by hash; attempt identity + seed bytes stored at mint. Typed-patch storage uses the same putEvidenceObject API (IMP-07 consumer).

The commit path links invalidated evidence ids (candidate-transaction contract) and the store links objects by hash. Per-critic/adjudication/quiz-phase linkage attaches through attachEvidenceObject; those call sites land with IMP-08's phased review + the acceptance lane.

Unexpected writes are first-class (IMP-01 unexpectedAttemptWrites → validation-failed terminal with reason). The isolated-workspace protocol IS the before/after proof (agent cwd is the only writable dir).

terminalStateForOutcome maps the frozen 10-value CandidateOutcomeV1 to disjoint states; provider_safeguard_or_refusal is DISTINCT from infrastructure_failure and content validation_failed (tested — never conflated).
Append-only 17-state journal (frozen AttemptStateV1) across manifest array + raw jsonl; reopen appends, never clobbers (resume-safe).

Object writes atomic (tmp→rename, content-addressed so a partial write never lands at its final hash); commit-pending + candidate/commit objects recorded BEFORE the canonical write, so a crash cannot yield a manifest claiming committed without the committed hash + bytes.

Six retention classes with bounded windows (migration-experiment 30d, temporary-workspace 7d, infra/rejected 90d) or explicit null (accepted-production, sensitive-source = owner decision); dry-run cleanup default.
planEvidenceCleanup REFUSES to delete active-state, cited (protectedRefs), or null-window evidence; dry-run by default; execute only on --execute.
redactEvidence strips secret-shaped values (OpenAI/AWS/Slack/GitHub/PEM/key=val) + the home path from every object and manifest field; idempotent; seeded-secret-absent proven (test + live CLI).

.evidence/ is gitignored, pipeline-local, OUTSIDE state/; excluded from chapter discovery/assembly/package/publish by construction (they scan state/ / copy one file). Path-shape test + IMP-12 forbidden-shadow gate.

reconstructAttempt rebuilds an attempt chronologically from manifest+objects (no debris scan) verifying every object hash; evidenceLineageGraph emits a machine-readable graph; evidence-reconstruct/evidence-cleanup CLI verbs.

Resume reconciliation: reopen appends (idempotent); the IMP-01 recoverIncompleteCommits reconciles pending commit brackets against canonical hashes; interrupted attempts reconstruct at their last state with no false terminal.

classifyEvidenceStaleness flags attempts whose recorded source-plan / execution-profile / renderer hashes no longer match the live pipeline (schema/version drift → explicit stale classification, not deletion).
The manifest carries inputHashes (incl. the IMP-02 drift-fingerprint inputs) + routeResultPath; evidenceLineageGraph + terminalState expose provider-outcome distribution to IMP-11/IMP-13.

testsRequired: manifest schema, hashing, append-only transition, migration
author / repair-patch / regeneration / review / acceptance lineage
testsRun: chapter-transaction / qc-transaction / author-arch / author-write-restore / source-use-plan / repair-lane (unperturbed — evidence OFF by default)
unresolvedRisks: Production evidence is OPT-IN (CHAPTERFLOW_EVIDENCE_ROOT / explicit root), not default-on: default-on would write the real .evidence/ from unit tests (a new leak the IMP-12 guard would flag) or need deep per-test threading. The mechanism is fully wired + tested; enabling it in the pipeline entry is a one-line owner config (IMP-13 controlled-activation philosophy).

Review/acceptance/critic-linkage call sites (items 4/6) attach through the same store API but wire in with IMP-08 (phased review) + the acceptance lane; the commit path already carries the invalidated-evidence list.

Verbatim codex --json usage/event capture (item 3) is IMP-11 telemetry — the local text route exposes no token/usage events today (recorded in IMP-02's gaps); the raw journal + card/final-message objects are captured now.
executionContextManifestPath defaults to the attempt-identity path at mint (mint precedes the spawn) and is upgraded to the IMP-00 spawn manifest post-spawn via linkExecutionContext.
dependencyAssumptions: IMP-08 attaches phased-review + quiz-derivation evidence via attachEvidenceObject.
IMP-07 stores typed patches + post-apply bytes via putEvidenceObject and carries sourcePlanHash lineage.
IMP-11 consumes evidenceLineageGraph + provider-outcome terminals + drift fingerprints for the bakeoff/statistics.
IMP-13 consumes stale-evidence classification + retention for canary requalification.
baselineHash is the IMP-12 commit (full sha); resultHash is sha256 of the staged unified diff.
